<script>
	site_cityID = '414';
	site_countryID = '15';
	site_cityName = 'Москва';
	site_countryName = 'Россия';
	site_domain = 'alta-karter.ru';
	site_moscowID = '414';
	page_address = 'alta-karter.ru/';
	site_apiUrl = 'https://api.alta-karter.ru:8190';

	$(document).ready(function(){
		$(document).on('click', '.pvz-list__switcher, .pvz-list__address, .show-pvz-selector', function(e){
			e.preventDefault();
			var city_id = $.cookie('CityID');

			PvzSelector.createWindow({
				city_id: city_id,
				country_name: site_countryName,
				city_name: site_cityName,
			});
		})

		var currentCity = {};
		var geoCitiesList = [];

		function showGeoSelector() {
			var geo = $('<div class="geo-selector with-spinner"></div>');
			$('body').append(geo);
			geo.Tabs = $('<div class="geo-selector__tabs"></div>').appendTo(geo);
			geo.Tabs.Country = $('<div class="tabs" data-id="geo-country"></div>').appendTo(geo.Tabs);
			geo.List = $('<div class="geo-selector__list"></div>').appendTo(geo);

			$('<div class="close geo-selector__close"></div>').appendTo(geo);

			if(geoCitiesList.length == 0) {
				$.ajax({
					dataType: "json",
					url: 'https://api.alta-karter.ru:8190/cities/all-cities',
					data: '',
					success: function(result) {
						geoCitiesList = result;
						setGeoData(geo);
					}
				});
			} else {
				setGeoData(geo);
			}
		}
		function setGeoData(geo) {
			geo.removeClass('with-spinner');

			var resultObj = {};
			// Страны
			for(var a = 0; a < geoCitiesList.length; a++) {
				var country = geoCitiesList[a];

				var countryID = 'country-'+country.id;

				var countryTab = $('<a data-target="'+countryID+'" class="tabs__tab">'+country.name+'</a>').appendTo(geo.Tabs.Country);

				var countryContent = $('<div class="'+countryID+' geo-selector__country" data-tab="geo-country"></div>').appendTo(geo.List);

				var currentCountry = (site_countryID == country.id);

				// Выделяем активную вкладку
				if(currentCountry) {
					countryTab.addClass('tabs__tab_active');
				} else {
					countryContent.addClass('hide');
				}

				var countryHeader = $('<div class="geo-selector__header"></div>').appendTo(countryContent);
				var countryLists = $('<div class="geo-selector__content"></div>').appendTo(countryContent);

				var countryObj = {};
				var cities = country.cities;

				// Формирование алфавитного списка
				for(var cityCount = 0; cityCount < cities.length; cityCount++) {
					var city = cities[cityCount];
					var firstLetter = city.name.substr(0,1);

					if(typeof(countryObj[firstLetter]) !== 'object') {
						countryObj[firstLetter] = [];
					}

					if(city.id == site_cityID) {
						city.current = true;
						currentCity = city;
					}

					countryObj[firstLetter].push(city);
				}

				// Список букв []
				var resultKeys = Object.keys(countryObj);

				// Разбор буквенного списка
				for(var f = 0; f < resultKeys.length; f++) {
					var letter = resultKeys[f];

					var letterEl = $('<div class="geo-selector__letter" data-geo-content="'+letter+'">'+letter+'</div>').appendTo(countryHeader);

					var citiesListEl = $('<div class="geo-selector__citiesList" data-geo-content-id="'+letter+'"></div>').appendTo(countryLists);

					// Определяем активную букву города
					if (
							(currentCountry && currentCity.name && letter == (currentCity.name).substr(0,1))
							|| (!currentCountry && f==0)
					) {
						letterEl.addClass('geo-selector__letter_current');
						citiesListEl.addClass('geo-selector__citiesList_current');
					}

					// Список городов по букве
					var citiesList = countryObj[letter];

					for(var c=0; c < citiesList.length; c++) {
						var city = citiesList[c];

						var cityEl = $('<span class="geo-selector__city" data-city-id="'+city.id+'">'+city.name+'<i class="geo-selector__region">'+city.region+'</i></span>').appendTo(citiesListEl);

						if(currentCity.id == city.id) {
							cityEl.addClass('geo-selector__city_current');
						}

						if(city.subdomain) {
							cityEl.data('subdomain', city.eng);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		$(document).on('click', '.show-geo-selector, .city-switcher__current', function(e){
			e.preventDefault();
			showGeoSelector();
		})

		$(document).on('click', '.geo-selector__close', function(e){
			$('.geo-selector').remove();
		});

		$(document).on('click', '.geo-selector__letter', function(e){
			var targetEl = e.target;
			var id = $(targetEl).data('geo-content');
			var parentEl = $(targetEl).parents('.geo-selector__country');

			parentEl.find('.geo-selector__letter_current').removeClass('geo-selector__letter_current');
			$(targetEl).addClass('geo-selector__letter_current');

			parentEl.find('.geo-selector__citiesList_current').removeClass('geo-selector__citiesList_current');
			parentEl.find('.geo-selector__citiesList[data-geo-content-id='+id+']').addClass('geo-selector__citiesList_current');
		})


		$(document).on('click', '.geo-selector__city', function(e){
			var cityEl = e.currentTarget;
			var cityId = $(cityEl).data('city-id');
			var subdomain = $(cityEl).data('subdomain');

			if(currentCity.id == cityId) {
				// Прекращаем все, когда узнаем, что выбран текущий город
				return;
			}

			site_cityID = cityId;

			if(cityId != site_moscowID) {
				$('.contact_city').addClass('show-geo-selector');
			} else {
				$('.contact_city').removeClass('show-geo-selector');
			}

			$('.geo-selector__city_current').removeClass('geo-selector__city_current');
			$(cityEl).addClass('geo-selector__city_current');

			// set Cookie
			$.cookie('CityID', cityId, { path: '/', domain: '.'+site_domain });
			$.removeCookie('PvzID', { path: '/', domain:'.'+site_domain });

			// redirect
			if(subdomain && subdomain != 'moscow') {
				// Всех кто имеет поддомены переадресовываем, кроме МСК
				location.href = '//'+subdomain+'.'+page_address;
			} else if (currentCity.subdomain){
				// Когда текущий город имеет поддомен, а новый НЕ имеет,
				// - отправляем на главный сайт, и Москву.
				location.href = '//'+page_address;
			} else {
				// или обновляем контент на странице
				$.ajax({
					url: 'https://api.alta-karter.ru:8190/cities/city/'+cityId,
					dataType:'json',
					success: function(result) {
						site_countryID = result['country-id'];
						site_cityName = result.name;
						site_countryName = result['country-name'];

						var contact = result.geocontacts;

						$('.contact_city').html(contact.DeliveryText);
						$('.contact_city, .delivery-url').attr('href',contact.DeliveryURL);
						$('.contacts').attr('href',contact.ContactURL);
						$('.city-switcher__current').html(result.name);

						if($('.product-delivery') && PvzSelector) {
							PvzSelector.update();
							if(result.np) {
								$('.pvz-list__np').show();
							} else {
								$('.pvz-list__np').hide();
							}
						}
						// default phones
						var phoneHead = '8 (495) <span class="phones__num">215 02 45</span>';
						var phoneLink = 'tel:+74952150245';

						var regPhone = /^([+\d]+\s?\(\d+\)\s?)(.+)$/;

						if (contact.Localphone) {
							phoneHead = (contact.Localphone).replace(/^\+?[7]/,'8');
							phoneHead = phoneHead.replace(/\-/g,' ');
							phoneHead = phoneHead.replace(regPhone, '$1<span class="phones__num">$2</span>')
							phoneLink = 'tel:'+(contact.Localphone).replace(/\D/g, '');
						}
						$('.header_phone_href').html(phoneHead);
						$('.header_phone_href').attr('href', phoneLink);

						$('.geo-selector').remove();
					}
				})
			}
		})
	})
</script>

<div id="layout">
<script>
	var toggleSidebar = function() {
		var sidebar = $('.sidebar');
		if(sidebar.hasClass('sidebar_active')) {
			sidebar.removeClass('sidebar_active');
			$('.shadow_sidebar').remove();
			$('body').removeClass('body_locked');
			menuControl.hide();
			$('.menu-link').removeClass('active');
			return false;
		} else {
			sidebar.addClass('sidebar_active');
			$('body').append('<div class="shadow_sidebar"></div>');
			$('body').addClass('body_locked');
			$('.menu-link').addClass('active');
			return true;
		}
	}
	
	$(document).on('click', '.sidebar__overlay, .menu-link, .shadow_sidebar, .sandwich, .sidebar__close', function(e){
		toggleSidebar();
	})

	var activeClass = 'side-menu__item_active';
	var menuControl = {
		toggle: function(t) {
			var subMenu = t.find('.side-menu__submenu');
			if(t && t.hasClass(activeClass)) {
				this.hide();
			} else if (subMenu.length) {
				this.show(t);
			}
		},
		show: function(t) {
			this.hide();
			var subMenu = t.find('.side-menu__submenu');
			if (subMenu.length) {
				t.addClass(activeClass);
				$('.sidebar').append('<div class="shadow_menu"></div>');
			}
		},
		hide: function() {
			$('.side-menu .'+activeClass).removeClass(activeClass);
			$('.sidebar .shadow_menu').remove();
		}
	};
	
	$(document).on('click', '.side-menu__item', function(e) {
		menuControl.toggle($(this));
	})
	$(document).on('click', '.shadow_menu', function(){
		menuControl.hide();
	})
</script>

<a class="border-button upload_content" data-page="1" href="javascript:void(0)">Посмотреть еще</a>
<script>
var loading = false;
var position = 0;
var page = 1;

$(document).on('click', '.upload_content', function() {
	var key = 1;
	$('.navigation').hide(500);
	var page = $(this).data('page');
	$('.upload_content').html('Загружаю');
	page = page + 1;
	$(this).data('page', page);

	if (page < 4) {
		setTimeout(load_products(page), 1500);
	} else {
		$('.upload_content').hide(500);
	}
});

$(window).scroll(function() {
	if ($('.upload_content').length > 0) {
		if ((($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height()) - 200) >= $('.upload_content').offset().top) {
			if (loading == false) {
				loading = true;
				if (position < $(window).scrollTop()) {
					position = $(window).scrollTop();
					$('.upload_content').trigger('click');
				}
			}
		}
	}
});

function load_products(page) {
	console.log('Loading page ' + page);
	$.ajax({
		url: '/index.php?route=common/load_home&page=' + page,
		type: 'GET',
		data: 'autoload=true',
		dataType: 'text',
		success: function(json) {
			//console.log(json);
			if (json != '') {
				if ($('.upload_content').length > 0) {
					$('.upload_content').html('Посмотреть еще');
				}
				$('.upload_content').before(json);
				loading = false;
			} else {
				if ($('.upload_content').length > 0) {
					$('.upload_content').hide(500);
				}
			}
		}
	});
}
</script>
